limitations: Developer suite passes are plausible repairs, not proof of semantic correctness.
Qwen hit conservative reservation guards on all three cases; this limits ability comparisons.
GLM had one truncated response and one tool-argument error; both remain in accounting.
Different providers and cache hits change actual costs.
Comparative totals exclude historical pilot/tuning costs and infrastructure.
Some trials aborted and remain unsealed; their journaled outcomes are preserved explicitly, not relabeled sealed trials.
protocol_changes: Original trials preserved. When a model error stopped unstarted cases, those cases were preregistered and executed separately, without retrying a started case. DeepSeek V4 Pro was added after initial observations at user request.
scope: exposed public development cases; convenience sample; no general model ranking or RSI claim
